targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-822c (2026-08-29, diagnostic, PASS, scoring_excluded) is the bug-fix re-run of 822b and it OVERTURNS the causal attribution this lineage has carried since 2026-07-28. Three things are now established. (1) THE LINEAGE'S HEADLINE NUMBER WAS NEVER MEASURED. `on_prop_delta_mean = off_prop_delta_mean = exactly 0.0` in V3-EXQ-822, 822a and 822b -- recorded in substrate_queue SD-082 failure_record [0] and [1] as a 'structural zero on both arms' -- is the empty-list default of `statistics.fmean(prop_deltas) if prop_deltas else 0.0`. n_prop_samples is 0 in ALL 18 cells across the three runs. The script's `_candidate_summaries()` called only `agent._candidate_world_summaries()`, which returns None on the default candidate_summary_source='proposer', so the P2 measurement and the P1 REINFORCE buffer were both starved on every tick of every cell. (2) THE 822b SUBSTRATE ATTRIBUTION WAS WRONG AT THE LAYER. failure_record [2] reads 'REINFORCE never updates rule_bias_head's last linear layer' and routed to tracing optimizer parameter registration / gradient flow through the tanh / ADV_MIN_THRESHOLD. The weight-norm read behind it was genuine (822b's post_p1 equalled init exactly, and a missing post_p1 would have yielded -0.148, not 0.0), but the CAUSE was that the driver's own REINFORCE loop never executed -- outcome_buf stayed empty, `_lpfc_reinforce_loss` hit its len<2 early return, and the optimiser step was skipped every episode. The substrate optimiser was never exercised at all. With the driver fixed, the head does train: last-layer norm delta moves from exactly 0.0 to 7.8e-05. (3) THE REAL DEFECT IS ONE LEVEL UPSTREAM AND IS STRUCTURAL. The per-candidate summary fed to compute_bias is `ws[0, 0, :]`, and e2_fast.py seeds `world_states = [initial_z_world]`, so index 0 is the rollout's shared initial world state -- bit-identical across all K candidates, because candidates differ only in the actions applied from t>=1. SD-082's centering (`summaries - summaries.mean(dim=0)`) then reduces it to float32 cancellation noise. The measured rule_summary_magnitude_ratio of 2.8e6-4.5e6 in all six cells (against a 1e3 ceiling) is exactly the scale float32 cancellation of near-identical O(1) vectors produces, and both agent.py paths use the same index, so this is unconditional on the default config. CONSEQUENCE: SD-082's stated acceptance criterion ('on_prop_delta_mean >= 0.001 with an ON>OFF contrast') is UNPASSABLE as currently wired -- the absolute floor is now cleared (0.001662) but it is cleared entirely by rule_state, which is candidate-invariant, so no ON>OFF contrast can exist. Both claims stay non_contributory: SD-078's downstream behaviour is still untested, and SD-082's centering mechanism is not falsified but UNTESTED, because its input never carried the cross-candidate variance it was designed to preserve. Route to /implement-substrate to amend SD-082 with a per-candidate summary source; the three existing failure_record entries should be marked superseded, not resolved, since nothing was fixed -- a later, better-instrumented run overturned the read.

Fix BOTH agent.py sites (the gated_policy block ~7185-7204 and the fallback ~7412-7424) -- they duplicate the same index. Also record rule_state_norm (already in get_state():485) and the pre/post-centering summary norms, so the ratio is decomposable next time.

learning_extracted: A no-data default that shares the numeric value of a meaningful result is the most expensive shape in this corpus. `statistics.fmean(xs) if xs else 0.0` produced an 'exactly 0.0' propagation delta that read as a strong structural finding, survived two confirmed autopsies, motivated a substrate landing and an amend, and stood for a month. The generic lesson is to make the empty case UNREPRESENTABLE in the manifest -- emit None/absent, or require the paired n_samples to be read alongside every aggregate -- rather than to remember to check n_samples.

The prior autopsy's discipline of separating gated from ungated readouts was CORRECT and is what makes this correction cheap. It explicitly reasoned that the precondition failure gated only the tick-sampled diagnostics and not the unconditional weight-norm snapshots, and it was right: the weight-norm zero was genuine. What it could not see is that BOTH the gated and ungated readouts shared a single upstream cause (the None short-circuit), so 'this readout is ungated' established that the number was real without establishing that its CAUSE was where the routing pointed. Ungated is not the same as unconfounded.

A diagnostic's label ladder is a design decision that can suppress its own best finding. 822c tests head_untrained (a threshold call at 7.8e-05 against 1e-3, on a proxy measure) BEFORE magnitude_imbalance (4000x over its ceiling, in all six cells, on a direct measure), and emits the former. Label ladders should be ordered by evidential strength or by causal depth, not by the order the hypotheses were written down.

`head_untrained_last_layer_static` is measured as a DIFFERENCE OF NORMS, which is not a movement measure: a weight matrix can rotate arbitrarily at constant norm and register zero. For a REINFORCE readout, rotation is the expected form of learning. Any future 'did this layer train' flag should use ||W_post - W_init|| against ||W_init||.

Centering is not a safe no-op on a degenerate input. SD-082's centering was designed to remove a common mode so that residual cross-candidate variance could survive; applied to an input that is constant across candidates by construction, it converts 'identical and O(1)' into 'float32 noise' and manufactures a 4e6 magnitude imbalance. A centering step should assert that its input has non-trivial cross-group variance before it is trusted.
